properties.site-address: Blyth Valley Venture Workshops, Plessey Road, Blyth
properties.notes: Site of a substantial building provided light industrial workshops that has been identified as surplus. Once fully vacated, demolition of the redundant building is required. Clearance undertake following an initial consent (14/02455/DEMGDO). This was followed by an application for construction of a mixed scheme of 38 houses, bungalows and apartment on the vacant site subsequently approved (15/02968/FUL). Development of 38 dwellings completed in 2018/19.
properties.ownership-status: not owned by a public authority
